test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GLEPK' is written as 'DIBMH' and 'QRYHN' is written as 'NOVEK'. How will 'POTER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

'GLEPK' is written as 'DIBMH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7fcb77ca1e356b56c7ea9979ac0dc6c70acd587afca91da0118b934f7f7a3f6.png] 

And,

 'QRYHN' is written as 'NOVEK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/10986c34b7d05a4f9fd0a7774daa6ca124ddd04dfb1a184f2f0567edfbe421c7.png] 

Similarly,

'POTER' will be written as: ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bb79a3bd9087763fe1c9d5c49d4b6f7300982fc79d958c784c4260888e06575.png] 

Hence, 'POTER' will be written in that language as **'MLQBO'.**
